notes: Portable C++ primary/contract and Java parity translate an independently green 26-assertion native HLA_EVOKED ordinary timestamped interaction retraction save/restore case. One time-regulating publisher sends and retracts a timestamped interaction, confirms the designator is terminal, saves, sends distinct post-save traffic, then restores. The saved handle remains MessageCanNoLongerBeRetracted while the discarded post-save handle is InvalidMessageRetractionHandle. The adapter supplies the installed provider, endpoint, IEEE 1516.2-2025 FOM with configured interaction class and parameter, logical-time implementation, and HLA_EVOKED callback configuration. Both portable languages explicitly select TIMESTAMP order via the standard service. Seven direct requirement-section pairs cover six clauses. Isolated portable C++ primary/contract passed against installed package libraries with HLAinteger64Time and HLAfloat64Time. Java compiles against the pinned official API-only JAR; Java provider runtime, HLA_IMMEDIATE, durable/process-restart restore, and interoperability remain unverified. This is experimental public-API evidence, not a conformance claim.
